items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public beta or full launch; counsel_required for Woot rights-dependent public display, alerts, affiliate, advertising, or monetization. Keep searchwoot.com private and keep external outreach unsent. Evidence: Woot API documentation establishes access but not redistribution rights; public terms restrict commercial/public use, storage, derivatives, prices, listings, and data mining. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, privacy, consent, vendor, incident, and owner gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional only when existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries are preserved. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.

Progress: 0 of 4 launch-readiness tasks closed; all 4 remain open. Existing evidence includes official API, terms, support, repository/configuration, privacy, cookie-policy, and draft-terms artifacts. No task closes because rights, field permissions, retention, deletion/correction/access workflows, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness, and rollback evidence remain incomplete. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Woot API deal and price-history data: blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level provenance, storage/caching/display/derivative/alert permissions, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review before any owner-authorized request. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed; produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed; capture consent, withdrawal, GA4 property/data-sharing, retention, and jurisdiction evidence without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed; produce a read-only log, vendor, access/retention, and incident inventory and route counsel-required gaps.

Technical compliance is a baseline, not certification: 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics quality is yellow because source permissions or collector errors remain; revenue covers 2026-09-21 only and includes $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable. Do not block ordinary reversible growth solely for incomplete telemetry, but preserve consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Do not approve rights-dependent monetization or public launch.

Keep searchwoot.com private and rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review. Continue the existing consolidated read-only evidence bundle; no public exposure, monetization, alert expansion, or production change is authorized.
